latest.notes:
Clean up spot audio that nothing uses.

• Deleting a commercial now offers to move its audio file to the Trash as well — but only when no other spot uses that file, and only for admin accounts. The confirmation tells you which case applies, so you always know whether the file is going.
• New in Traffic ▸ Commercials: "Unused Spot Audio…" lists every spot asset no commercial points at, with an option to move them all to the Trash. It only reads until you ask, so it is safe to look first.
• Both skip anything playing, armed, or under a talk-over, and both use the Finder Trash, so Put Back restores a file you change your mind about.

Worth running once after updating to see what has accumulated from past deletions.

Includes v0.5.87: hand-off diagnostics for the intermittent late start.
